title: Box and unbox annotated primitive type names
summary: Annotated boolean boxed and unboxed successfully. Two distinct type-use annotations on an independently built Integer survived both conversions in their original order.

change.description: Match primitives and wrappers by their unannotated type, then carry the annotation list to the converted type.

notes: The two distinct annotations reveal duplication, reversal or loss. Starting with a separately constructed wrapper exercises equality across instances.
